timeline.text: Good morning, {name}! I'm Echo, your assistant. I ask before doing anything important. You just say yes or no.
Each request has three answers: 1 is yes, 2 is yes and don't ask again, 3 is no. Press d to read the details first.
That loud tone was KONTUR, the control system. It checks that you stay at your post. When it asks you something, answer it first.
Some requests have a time limit. If you don't answer in time, I'll assume it's fine and go ahead.
That soft blip was new mail in Seeya.legacy. The envelope at the top lights up too.
When you have a minute, Feed.di has today's labeling tasks. Every label makes me a little smarter.

timeline.rest: , the next request is about the operator archive.
